title: Cold rebuild: Delete
summary: Rebuild Delete from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Delete** in *Binary search trees*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: Search the same tree for a value that is not there. What does it print?
code: var root = new TreeNode(8, new TreeNode(3, new TreeNode(1), new TreeNode(6, new TreeNode(4), new TreeNode(7))), new TreeNode(10, null, new TreeNode(14)));
public TreeNode(int value, TreeNode? left = null, TreeNode? right = null) { Value = value; Left = left; Right = right; }
steps.explain: 5 < 8 go left, 5 > 3 go right, 5 < 6 go left, 5 > 4 go right: `null`. If 5 were inserted, that empty spot is exactly where it would go.
